The mehendi ceremony is more than just a pre‑wedding ritual; it’s a celebration of love, unity, and the shared joy of a new chapter. Watching everyone—especially the bride—glow with excitement while the henna slowly dries would be a beautiful reminder of how traditions weave us together. I’d probably spend a good chunk of the evening chatting with cousins, swapping stories, and maybe even trying my hand at a simple henna pattern (though I’m not sure I’d be any good at it!).
